stemBlocks: An object of mass 20 kg is pulled up a rough plane inclined at 30° to the horizontal by a light, inextensible cable attached via a frictionless pulley to a freely-falling 30 kg mass. The acceleration of the object along the plane is $2.5 \text{ ms}^{-2}$.
What is the frictional force between the object and the plane?
(Air resistance and the mass of the pulley can be ignored. The gravitational field strength $g$ is $10 \text{ N kg}^{-1}.)$
